title: Winter
summary: A late-night city in the rain — wet pavement, neon in puddles, and a jazz club glowing at the end of the block.
rules: Keep everything nocturnal, wet, and lived-in. Cool blue-black streets with warm amber windows and neon reflections in puddles. Rain on glass, umbrellas, taxis, saxophones, vinyl, and tiny figures hurrying between doorways. No sunshine, no dry pavement, no empty clubs — always weather and music in the air.
prompt: Museum-quality handcrafted miniature diorama of a rainy jazz-city night. Hyperrealistic physical materials: wet cobblestone, glossy puddles, neon signage, brass instruments, vinyl sleeves, rain-streaked windows. Cool cinematic night lighting with warm club lamps and colored neon bouncing off the rain. Every place feels like somewhere you’d wait out the storm with a drink and a record playing.
